correctness.rationale: Exact stationary generator recurrence proves the active coordinate variance and fourth cumulant; independent thermal Gaussian addition preserves the latter. At each positive fixed variance the inverse trap time exists uniquely, the active variance does not increase with angular-to-trap ratio, and an explicitly differentiated rational fourth-cumulant factor strictly decreases for all positive ratios and dimensions at least two. Two sharp but unattained limits complete the injectivity and if-and-only-if attainable region. Included standard-library checker passed 362 exact-rational and independent numerical assertions, which are diagnostics rather than infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The original same-model source supplies the forward variance and fourth-moment formulas, but no global two-rate inversion or sharp joint attainable region; the assessed theorem proves a strictly decreasing fourth-cumulant magnitude on every fixed-variance level set. The moment-recursion paper treats forward distributions, and the stationary-shape paper treats mode transitions. The closest checked index results concern joint resetting, finite-tumble dynamics, or shape-anisotropic passive diffusion, not the present nonreset ABP inverse; an equivalent unindexed computation remains possible.
residual_risks: The primary source already provides the necessary forward moments; algebraic restatements are not novel and only the rigorous complete inverse/attainability theorem is assessed.
An equivalent unindexed or differently phrased derivation may already exist; neither searches nor database partitions prove uniqueness.
Finite sample statistical identifiability and conditioning are separate issues not established here.

value.rationale: A calibrated active microswimmer has two hidden physical relaxation rates. The theorem gives their exact global structural identification and sharp feasibility from just two one-coordinate snapshot moments; variance by itself leaves a continuum of indistinguishable rates. Reentrant kurtosis at fixed model parameters makes global injectivity under a fixed measured variance a meaningful non-obvious question. It avoids requiring orientation tracking or temporal measurement under explicit calibrated assumptions, and identifies sharp limiting ill-conditioning.
